layers.name: Tensor package substrate
layers.info: Laminate substrate under the flip-chip die. Package size approximate.

parts.name: Google Tensor die
parts.info: Tensor (GS101): Samsung-built SoC derived from an Exynos design, with Google's TPU and ISP blocks.

specs.CPU: 2x Cortex-X1 2.80 GHz + 2x Cortex-A76 2.25 GHz + 4x Cortex-A55 1.80 GHz

parts.name: PoP interconnect balls
parts.info: Solder balls around the die that carry the memory bus up to the stacked DRAM (one row shown).

layers.name: LPDDR5 package substrate
layers.info: Bottom of the stacked memory package.

parts.name: LPDDR5 dies
parts.info: Stack of DRAM dies (count and size approximate).

layers.name: LPDDR5 mold cap
layers.info: Epoxy mould over the DRAM; the top face of the chip visible on the board. The Pixel 6 Pro unit had Micron 12 GB (MT62F1536M64D8CH-031); the Pixel 6 has 8 GB, vendor unconfirmed.
